_comment: Mo Store catalogue v2 (docs/MO_STORE.md). The signed authority for everything that is not an ordinary Flathub app: web addresses, publisher download URLs with their exact size and SHA-256, Android signers, executables inside archives and window classes. 'source':'flathub' entries install by id and carry no recipe; 'source':'moos' entries carry an install recipe whose kind is one of webapp, appdrop, windows-portable, android, vendor-rpm, npm or web. Nothing here is mirrored by MoOS: every download is the publisher's own URL. build_files/verify_store_catalog.py is the gate for every field.
